title: The Dancing Idli - Boing Boing Song | Manipuri Kids Song, Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Amma's fluffy idli wakes up and dances on the plate! Brother wants chips, but the idli just wants to be eaten while it's hot.
A fun song about sharing, trying new foods, and enjoying meals with family.
